{{Quote|Heralds of Zildrog. Cultists longing for the return of a mythical serpent god. Used to be they were just a nuisance. Now they're militant.|[[Senya Tirall]]|<ref name="KotFE 7" />}}
The '''Heralds of Zildrog, '''also known simply as '''Heralds''', were a nihilistic, [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]], Force-using cult from [[Zakuul]].

==Description==
{{Quote|We give ourselves to Zildrog's glory so that the wicked may be punished. We die so that Zakuul may live on.|Acolyte of the Heralds of Zildrog|<ref name="KotFE 7" />}}
Worshiping [[Zildrog]], a mythical dragon predating the Zakuulan pantheon of [[Izax]], the Heralds believed that Zildrog's second coming was imminent, and with it the end and remaking of the world.<ref name="KotFE 7" />

The Heralds appeared to be comprised largely of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals, and many used lightsabers as their primary weapon.<ref name="KotFE 7" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Heralds run the Old World now. They made a deal. Heralds keep crime down, and the Knights keep out.|[[Reg]]|<ref name="KotFE 7" />}}
[[File:Heralds_of_Zildrog.png|thumb|left|250px|[[The Exalted]] and his followers]]
Though considered heretical by mainline Zakuulan religions, the Heralds reached a truce with [[Arcann]] during his time as Emperor of the [[Eternal Empire]]. Arcann gave the Heralds jurisdiction over keeping the peace in the [[Old World]] of Zakuul, excluding the area from the jurisdiction of the [[Knights of Zakuul]], who usually handled law enforcement.<ref name="TOR:HoZ" />

The Heralds' role in policing the Old World would put them in conflict with the individual known as [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] when the Outlander came to their headquarters in [[District 1327|Breaktown]] in search of the [[SCORPIO|Lady of Sorrows]], an information broker operating in the area. When the Outlander came before [[the Exalted]] of the Heralds in order to secure an audience with the Lady, the Exalted ordered the Outlander killed despite orders from the Lady not to. The Exalted and his Heralds then reported back to the Lady, who had kidnapped [[Brennen]], the Exalted's son. For his disobedience, the Lady killed the old Exalted, and installed Brennen as new Exalted.<ref name="KotFE 7" />

Several Heralds also joined up with [[Order of Zildrog]] following the rise of the [[Eternal Alliance]]. Many of those who joined were killed during the Alliance [[Mission to Nathema (Zildrog)|mission to Nathema]].<ref name="TOR:TOoZ" />
